recordType.description: Identifies the record as a header record.

fileName.description: Unique file name for each type of file, such as Person, Employment, or Relationship.

fileType.description: Identifies the file type. The file type must match the extension of the file itself.

sourceId.description: Unique identifier associated with the vendor sending the file.

createDate.description: File creation date. Defaults to the effective date if none is provided.

createTimestamp.description: File creation timestamp. Defaults to the timestamp of the effective date if none is provided.

periodBeginDate.description: Marks the beginning of the data period. Typically defaults to the first day of the previous month unless otherwise defined by the client.

periodEndDate.description: Marks the ending of the data period. Typically defaults to the last day of the previous month unless otherwise defined by the client.

recordCount.description: Number of person records in the file.

person.description: Collection of person records contained in the file.

uniqueId.description: Primary participant identifier. This could be the SSN or Employee ID as determined by the project team.

firstName.description: Person's first name. Must reflect the employee's legal name as maintained on the employee's employment record.

middleName.description: Person's middle name. Must reflect the employee's legal name as maintained on the employee's employment record.

lastName.description: Person's last name. Must reflect the employee's legal name as maintained on the employee's employment record.

taxIdNumber.description: SSN or ITIN of the person being reported. SSN is required unless applicable foreign-national reporting rules allow the SSN to be omitted.

taxIdType.description: Identifies whether the reported tax identification number is an SSN or ITIN.

usCitizen.description: Indicates whether the individual is a US citizen.

dateOfBirth.description: Represents the person's date of birth.

dateOfDeath.description: Represents the person's date of death, when applicable.

personType.description: Represents the type of person. Available options are defined in the Person Type valid values.

gender.description: Represents the person's gender. Available options are defined in the Gender valid values.

maritalStatus.description: Represents the person's marital status. Available options are defined in the Marital Status valid values.

maritalStatusEffectiveDate.description: Represents the date as of which the person's marital status is effective.

title.description: Represents the person's title. Available options are defined in the Title valid values.

languagePreference.description: Represents the person's language preference. Available options are defined in the Language valid values.

disabilityStatus.description: Represents the disability status of the person.

disabilityStatusEffectiveDate.description: Represents the date as of which the person's disability status is effective.

veteranStatusEffectiveDate.description: Represents the date as of which the person's veteran status is effective.

medicareEligible.description: Indicates whether the person is eligible for Medicare.

medicareEligDate.description: Represents the date as of which the person's Medicare eligibility is effective.

primaryAddressType.description: Indicates the person's primary address type.

primaryPhoneType.description: Indicates the person's primary phone type.

primaryEmailType.description: Indicates the person's primary email type.

preferredCommunication.description: Indicates the person's preferred communication method.

addresses.description: Nested address information associated with the person. The source supports work, home, and alternate address records.

address.description: Collection of address records associated with the person.

addressType.description: Indicates the type of address, such as home, work, or alternate.

zipCode.description: ZIP or postal code associated with the address.

foreignAddressLine.description: Foreign address information when the country code is other than USA.

emails.description: Nested email information associated with the person. The source supports work, personal, and alternate email records.

email.description: Collection of email records associated with the person.

emailType.description: Type of email address, such as personal, work, or alternate.

email.description: Email address associated with the person.

comment.description: Additional comment associated with the email address.

phones.description: Nested phone information associated with the person. The source supports work, personal, and alternate phone records.

phone.description: Collection of phone records associated with the person.

phoneType.description: Type of phone number, such as personal, work, or alternate.

countryCode.description: Country calling code associated with the phone number.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number associated with the person.

comment.description: Additional comment associated with the phone number.

employeeId.description: Unique employee identifier. This is the internal payroll employee number.

sourceAssignmentId.description: Assignment key used to identify a job when an employee has the same employee ID across multiple jobs under the same employer.

employerCode.description: Unique employer code generated by BenefitsIQ and used by the employer when providing the file.

originalHireDate.description: Original hire date of the employee.

adjustedHireDate.description: Adjusted hire date of the employee, when applicable.

terminationDate.description: Termination date of the employee, when applicable.

participatingGroupCode.description: Code identifying the employee's participating group.

workAuthorizationStatus.description: Work authorization status of the employee.

supervisorEmail.description: Email address of the employee's supervisor.

annuitantClaimNumber.description: Annuitant claim number associated with the employee.
